children: The USDA says the pace of early harvesting in the U.S. is exceeding that of this time last year, as well as the 5-year average pace. The government says corn is 13% harvested, while soybeans are 12% complete--with corn 3 points ahead of this time last year, while soybeans are 4 points ahead of last year's pace. Rainfall this week may slow down harvest progress, says Michael Cordonnier of Soybean and Corn Advisor in a note-- although the central plains should dry out later this week. Most-active corn is down 0.5%, soybeans drop 0.4%, and wheat is off 1%. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
